description: Startups ranked by how many of your tracked accounts recently followed them. Startups only: a result must be marked a company in our curated companies table (entity type company, project, protocol or product) with at most 25,000 X followers. People, investors, VC firms, media, organizations, public companies and big established brands are left out, as is anything not yet classified. classify=true attaches the cached classification to each result. frontrun_companies stays the full catalog. Default window 7d. classify=true uses more usage per item classified.

max_credits.description: Optional spend ceiling for this one call. Fails closed: if the call could use more, nothing runs and nothing is charged.

scope.description: Whose follows to read: "tracked" (default, your tracked accounts), "network" (the whole Frontrun network, paid Pro plans) or "list:<id>" (one of your lists from frontrun_lists, with its sectors).

name: frontrun_trending
